observations: Photo 0 and photo 1 show the same black-on-black monocrystalline solar panel, full-black frame, standing outdoors against a wall with other panels visible in the background.
No specification label, wattage sticker, or junction box is visible in either photo.
Overlaid text reads 'Innoson Global Group' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' – this is a watermark from the listing platform/reseller account, not a manufacturer plate on the panel.
No brand name, model number, or wattage rating is legible anywhere on the panel itself.
Panel surface shows reflections/glare but no visible cracks, chips, or discoloration from this distance.
Ground and surroundings look like an outdoor storage/yard, not a controlled test setup.

claims.claim: High Quality Solar Panels, Inverters, Lithium & Tubular Batteries, Charge[controllers]
claims.evidence: Only a solar panel is shown in the two photos; no inverters, batteries, or charge controllers are pictured, and 'high quality' is a subjective claim with no spec sheet or test shown.

risks.risk: Wattage/power rating unknown – this is the main price driver for solar panels and is not legible in either photo.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rear specification sticker showing model number, wattage (W), Voc, Isc, and Vmp.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced even at worst case, since price range for 'a solar panel' spans too widely without wattage

risks.risk: Panel may not actually produce rated power (micro-cracks, cell damage, or degraded output are invisible in photos).
risks.proof: Video or photo of a multimeter/clamp meter connected to the panel in direct sunlight showing voltage/current output.

risks.risk: Junction box and cable condition (connectors, MC4 plugs, weatherproofing) unknown – affects installability and safety.
risks.proof: Photo of the back of the panel showing the junction box and cable ends.

risks.risk: Panel could be used/refurbished rather than new despite clean appearance.
risks.proof: Photo of manufacture date sticker or original packaging/invoice.

risks.risk: Hidden surface damage (micro-cracks, hotspots) not visible at this photo distance and glare.
risks.proof: Close-up, glare-free photos of each corner and the full cell grid, plus an EL/thermal image if available.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the rear specification label showing brand, model, and wattage.
Video of the panel under sunlight with a multimeter showing open-circuit voltage.
Photo of the junction box and cable connectors on the back.
Close-up, glare-free shots of the full panel surface for crack/damage check.
Any purchase receipt, warranty card, or manufacture-date sticker.
response.reason: The photos show a solar panel but no readable wattage/spec label, which is the key figure that sets its price bracket, so not even a worst-case price can be assigned without that shot.
